title: Testing Intervention Strategies for Addressing Binge Eating and Food Insecurity
official: Testing Intervention Strategies for Addressing Binge Eating and Food Insecurity
summary: The purpose of this study is to conduct a randomized trial to assess whether different stipend distribution schedules and access to a mobile intervention can help reduce binge eating and improve food security status among adults experiencing food insecurity and recurrent binge eating.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult 18 years or older
* English-speaking
* Non-pregnant
* Recurrent binge eating (≥12 episodes in the past 3 months)
* Low or very low food security (score ≥2 on the 6-item 30-day Short Form Food Security Survey)
* Willing to use a mobile application
* Has a smartphone with Internet access and capacity for calls and text messaging
* Has a valid email address
* Willing to complete a W-9 form
* Have an active U.S. bank account to which they can and are willing to receive electronic funds transfer

Exclusion Criteria:

* BMI of less than 19.5
* Diagnosis for which the study/intervention is not clinically indicated
* Currently working with a clinical professional to receive services for weight management or binge eating
* Started or recently changed (within past month) dosage for a medication for weight loss or binge eating
